lines.trans: You all fought like dogs.
Andrea, she is the pitbull.
You never gave up all year.
Mathias, he is the hunting dog.
An exceptional instinct.
Arlette, she is Jean Gabin.
She always takes you where she wants.
It could have been excellent without a disaster.
To fire a partner, you must prove misconduct.
Wait, what is going on here?
The serious misconduct is having lied.
I understand, I am leaving.
Such a decision is made between us!
Does everyone deserve a second chance?
From now on, we do everything together!
